0.3.0.notes: Display Settings page in the game's Options (title and pause): display mode, resolution, aspect / widescreen, backgrounds, HUD anchor, render scale, VSYNC, frame rate (60 stock, or interpolated up to the display's refresh rate). Applies live.

0.2.0.notes: First-person view in the shop (Button 4 cycles to it): eyes at Recette's head, mouse look at the display's refresh rate, WASD, left click = confirm, right click / Tab = menu. Settings: field of view, sensitivity, invert Y.

0.1.0.notes: A free orbit camera as an extra entry in the shop's Button-4 camera cycle: rotate, zoom, height (keys, right-drag, pad). Cutscenes hand back to the game's camera.

0.2.0.notes: The full title menu whatever the saves hold: all 8 entries; New Game+ and Survival from any slot (an empty slot = a fresh start). Writes nothing to save.dat.

0.1.1.notes: Recolour Recette (hair, eyes, clothes: 10 regions) from an Options page: presets or per-region colours, live preview. Works on your own game files at load time; nothing is written to the game folder.
